Washington's NAICS 54 (Professional, scientific, and technical services) private covered employment has run in the rough neighborhood of 250,000 jobs in recent QCEW data: Washington is a national tech/professional-services hub, so its NAICS 54 level should be at or above its ~2.3% share of the roughly 11.5 million U.S. PST-services jobs (about 265,000+), with part of the state's tech workforce classified under software publishing (NAICS 511) and information (51) rather than 54. Option A (253,782) fits this profile, including the typical modest December (month-3) seasonal dip below the Q4 quarterly average. Option B (208,942) would put Washington below its national population share in this sector, which is implausible for a state anchored by the Seattle tech and professional-services cluster. Therefore the December 2024 private-sector covered employment level for NAICS 54 is best supported as 253,782 covered jobs.
